business_scope.primary_industry_name: Interactive Audio Chatroom and Companion Social Applications

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (Metropolitan and overseas departments; single national jurisdiction, no separate sub-state corporate register)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Napoleonic system; unitary national legal order with commercial and monetary codes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–United States Double Taxation Convention (signed 31 August 1994, amended by Protocol signed 13 January 2009) — DTA
France–China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 30 November 1984, amended by Protocol signed 2 December 2013) — DTA
France–Germany Double Taxation Agreement (with Supplementary Convention) — DTA
EU–Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), provisionally applied since 21 September 2017 — FTA

Network of 110+ bilateral investment treaties administered by the French Republic (e.g., France–Algeria, France–Qatar, France–Egypt), subject to periodic review and the post-Achmea termination of intra-EU BITs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), articles L.561-1 to L.561-61 and R.561-1 to R.561-64 as amended by Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 12 février 2020 and Décret n° 2020-110 du 13 février 2020, transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843 and aligning with Regulation (EU) 2024/1624; Code de commerce, articles L.123-10-1 and L.210-3; Décret n° 2016-691 du 28 mai 2016 and Code de commerce article R.561-2 governing the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); Loi n° 2024-364 du 22 avril 2024 on anti-money laundering and terrorist financing; Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act) and Directive (EU) 2021/514 (DAC7) applicable to the digital voice-streaming business model.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — pursuant to the CJEU judgment of 22 November 2022 (Joined Cases C-37/20 and C-601/20), public access to the French RBE was withdrawn; access is limited to TRACFIN, ACPR, judicial authorities and obliged entities (credit institutions, notaries, lawyers) filing a statutory legitimate-interest request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (or EU/EEA national identity card) of each natural-person UBO and of the proposed Gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or other competent certifying authority in the document holder's state of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille pursuant to the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 (France is a contracting state), plus certified French translation where the source is non-French

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing and officers list of any non-French corporate shareholder (corporate UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry (e.g., UK Companies House, Hong Kong Companies Registry, Delaware Secretary of State)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and certified legal translation into French; Consular Legalization only if the issuing state is not a Hague Convention party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized general or special power of attorney executed by the future shareholders and Gérant in favor of the French incorporation counsel (required for foreign signatories)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and certified French translation; original signatures must be witnessed or digitally introduced in accordance with French digital-notarial rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Recent proof of residential or business address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last three months) for each UBO and the Gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution issuing the underlying statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified translation into French; consular legalization only for non-Hague Convention states

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each UBO, corporate shareholder and the Gérant against (i) the consolidated EU sanctions list (Regulation (EU) No. 269/2014 and 833/2014 as amended), (ii) the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, (iii) the French national financial sanctions list maintained by the Direction générale du Trésor, (iv) the OFAC SDN list where any USD clearing is involved, and (v) TRACFIN and ACPR publications. Conduct screening at onboarding, at each transaction aggregation threshold of EUR 10,000, and immediately upon sanction-list updates. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory under CMF art. L.561-10-2 for any PEP, for UBOs resident in higher-risk jurisdictions, and given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier of the ISIC 6311 voice-streaming social application; EDD shall include source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, senior-management approval, and accelerated transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) with filing through the official Guichet unique portal at https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; name pre-reservation and search performed via the INPI portal (data.inpi.fr) covering RCS trade names, France's national trademark database and EUIPO TMview.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French is mandatory for the legal dénomination sociale and all statutory corporate documents under Act No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (loi Toubon). The name must be expressed in Latin script; foreign-language elements are permitted only when accompanied by a French transliteration and appear in a French-language legal name registered with the RNE. The name must not be contrary to public order or evoke, alone or in combination, a false link to French or EU public authorities; INPI applies the protections of the Code de la propriété intellectuelle, article L.711-4, against conflict with prior trademarks and official emblems.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'République', 'Ministère', 'Préfecture', 'Police', 'Gendarmerie', 'National' when used to suggest state authority — prior ministerial approval required
'Banque', 'Crédit', 'Finance', 'Établissement de paiement' — regulated credit institution terms requiring ACPR authorization
'Assurance', 'Mutuelle', 'Courtage' — regulated insurance or mutual terms requiring ACPR approval
'Avocat', 'Notaire', 'Expert-Comptable', 'Huissier' — regulated liberal professions with title protection
'Croix-Rouge', 'ONU', 'Union Européenne' and other protected international emblems or misleading official designations
Geographic names such as 'Ville de Paris', 'Département de...', or 'Région...' that falsely imply a local public authority or administrative endorsement
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: INPI name reservations are valid for 35 days and are not renewable; upon expiry a new reservation may be filed for the same name if still available. If INPI refuses a name reservation, the applicant shall (1) file an administrative response with INPI within two months of notification in accordance with Code de la propriété intellectuelle article R.712-17; (2) if the refusal is maintained, lodge an appeal to the Cour d'appel de Paris within one month of the final decision pursuant to Article L.411-4; (3) simultaneously reserve an alternative distinct name to avoid incorporation delay. If the rejection arises from the greffe du tribunal de commerce during registration of the SARL, the applicant may petition the supervising judge of the Tribunal judiciaire within one month, or correct the file and resubmit through the Guichet unique; legal counsel should in all cases issue a trademark-conflict opinion before appellate steps.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this industry: French law requires a siège social within national territory (Code de commerce, articles L.210-3 and L.223-1) but expressly permits domiciliation at a commercial domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) holding a prefecture authorization, pursuant to Code de commerce articles L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-6. A fully digital voice-streaming social application with no customer-facing premises and charging exclusively through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing qualifies for such domiciliation. The domiciliation contract is limited to five years, renewable, and must include a physical reception point and dedicated mailing address; multi-domiciliation of numerous companies at one address increases AML/CFT scrutiny.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 10% annual probability of an unannounced on-site verification (contrôle de domiciliation) conducted by the Direction générale des finances publiques (DGFiP), the commercial court registry or judicial police; the likelihood increases to approximately 25% when the registered office is a private home address or a non-approved domiciliation address. For a Medium_Risk_Enhanced digital platform, TRACFIN and ACPR may include the office address in broader compliance reviews, but no statutory industry-specific physical presence requirement applies to ISIC 6311.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI Guichet unique / RNE incorporation filing fee (SARL creation including UBO register declaration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by INPI order under Code de commerce articles R.123-1 et seq.; excludes professional fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the statutory incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in a prefecture-approved legal announcements journal (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Approved Journal d'annonces légales in the jurisdictional area of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated market tariff per notice; required by Code de commerce article R.210-4

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation service — 12-month contract at a prefecture-authorized commercial domiciliation company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for basic domiciliation (letterbox, reception, handling) under Code de commerce articles L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-6

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Opening of blocked bank account and issuance of capital deposit certificate (attestation de blocage des fonds)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank tariff for account opening and fund-blocking certificate; governed by Code de commerce article L.223-7

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, certification and apostille of UBO and foreign corporate documents (passport copies, power of attorney, corporate extracts)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in country of origin and competent apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary fee schedule of the issuing jurisdiction plus Hague Apostille administrative tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of good standing and corporate extract of the non-French corporate shareholder (if applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registry fee schedule of the issuing state; validity limited to 90 days for RBE filing purposes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Automated PEP, OFAC, EU and UN consolidated sanctions screening for each UBO and the Gérant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML data provider (e.g., World-Check, Dow Jones Risk and Compliance or equivalent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-search or per-subject market benchmark; mandatory for the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier under CMF article L.561-10-2

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Trademark and domain pre-clearance legal report (INPI data, EUIPO TMview, WHOIS review)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French intellectual-property counsel and official public search portals
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Flat legal research fee; official database access is free of charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French counsel pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO piercing memorandum, statutory drafting (statuts) and corporate filing supervision — fixed fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm (cabinet d'avocats) admitted to a French bar
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for a standard SARL incorporation; approximately three to five senior-associate days including AML verification

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL regime); Article L.210-2 (lawful purpose); Decree n° 2021-1088 on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); Ordonnance n° 2020-158 liberalising capital formation; Code civil Articles 1832 to 1872.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris (Registry Clerk of the Commercial Court), acting through the single electronic window 'Guichet Unique' operated by INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de Création d'Entreprise (company creation statement, historical M0 form) together with the signed Statuts (Articles of Association) and all ancillary dossiers enumerated below; registration is evidenced by the Extrait Kbis issued by the Greffe.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to a SARL (the capital is freely fixed, commonly EUR 1 or EUR 10,000). Since 1 January 2021 (Ordonnance n° 2020-158), cash contributions need not be paid at subscription unless the Statuts so provide; any cash contribution actually paid must be deposited with a French bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and remain blocked until RCS registration, as evidenced by a certificat de dépôt de fonds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION — SHARE SUBSCRIPTION. The sole incorporator acknowledges subscription of the entire share capital of EUR 10,000, divided into 1,000 ordinary shares, fully subscribed and provisionally paid into the blocked corporate account, evidenced by the deposit certificate. SECOND RESOLUTION — REGISTERED OFFICE. The incorporator adopts 12 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris as the registered office (siège social) and authorizes the gérant to transfer it within Paris pending completion of formalities. THIRD RESOLUTION — APPOINTMENT. M. Jean Martin is appointed gérant for an indefinite term, with sole signing authority to open bank accounts, publish the legal notice, file through the Guichet Unique, and complete post-registration declarations. All resolutions are adopted unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the French Statuts (Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate counsel (avocat) or notary, prior to submission through the INPI Guichet Unique portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Statuts in French, setting out the corporate form (SARL), registered office, corporate purpose limited to interactive voice streaming and companion social applications (ISIC 6311 / NAICS 519130), capital and share splitting, the gérant's powers and decision-making rules. Execute physically or by qualified electronic signature. Coordinate the capital contribution schedule with the bank step.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each partner
Recent proof of address (utility bill under 3 months)
Detailed business purpose statement
Shareholder register and ownership schedule
Capital contribution plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe later flags the Statuts as ambiguous, the consent of all partners is obtained to pass a corrigeant resolution; invalid or ambiguous clauses are severed or amended by a supplementary act filed within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the French corporate bank account and blocking of subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French commercial bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a current account in the name of the 'SARL en formation', deposit the subscribed cash contributions, and obtain the certificate of deposit of funds (certificat de dépôt de fonds / attestation de blocage). The funds remain blocked until the Greffe delivers the RCS entry, at which point the SARL unblocks them.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts
Identity documents of partners and the gérant
AML/KYC questionnaire and beneficial ownership statement
Proof of address of the entity under formation
Business plan or anticipated turnover figures for risk scoring
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account (right to object under the Code monétaire et financier), the incorporator may request the Banque de France to exercise the droit au compte, which designates the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations or another credit institution as a fallback.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the statutory legal notice (annonce légale) of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An approved legal gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales) of the Paris department, e.g. BALO or a private JAL authorised by the Préfet
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Insert a formal notice containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, names of managers and the proposed RCS registration jurisdiction. Request the attestation de parution (certificate of publication), which must be produced at the filing stage within six months of publication.
required_dossiers: Final Statuts draft
Notice text prepared by counsel
Partner resolution approving the notice wording
Capital and officer details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice contains inaccurate data, the same gazette or another authorised gazette publishes a corrective notice (rectificatif), and the corrected attestation replaces the original.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the creation declaration via the Guichet Unique and payment of duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitting the dossier to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris for RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online creation file for a SARL, upload all dossiers, self-certify the absence of criminal disqualifications (déclaration sur l'honneur / non-condamnation), and settle the greffe duties (droit fixe) and related taxes electronically. All mandatory attachments must be in French or accompanied by a certified translation.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts
Certificat de dépôt de fonds from the bank
Attestation de parution of the legal notice
Proof of registered office occupancy (bail, attestation du propriétaire or domiciliation agreement)
Copies of partners' and gérant's identity cards
Déclaration de création (M0 data fields)
Beneficial owner declaration (art. L.561-2-1 Code monétaire et financier)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The greffe must act within 15 days of receipt of a complete file; if it issues a query (en attente de pièces), the missing items must be supplied within the stipulated deadline; a formal refusal is contestable before the president of the tribunal de commerce within 10 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration, SIREN attribution and issuance of the Extrait Kbis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris and INSEE (Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation, the Greffe assigns the SIREN number, records the company at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, and issues the Extrait Kbis, which is the quasi-conclusive proof of legal existence of the SARL. INSEE generates the SIRET code, and URSSAF is automatically notified for employer registration.
required_dossiers: No additional document — relies upon the validated Guichet Unique file
Kbis application generated by the registry system
Confirmation of payment of duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis reveals any divergence with the Statuts, an online rectification is filed; if registration is refused, the incorporator has 15 days to supplement the file and may ultimately refer the dispute to the President of the Commercial Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration governance and digital activity compliance (CNIL, DSA, URSSAF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE, URSSAF, CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés) and the Digital Services Act enforcement authorities as applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon Kbis issuance, file the beneficial ownership register (RBE), adopt the internal governance books (register of deliberations), register the online voice-chat activity as an online platform under the Digital Services Act, designate the CNIL data protection officer (the app processes voice metadata and personal data), validate the Privacy Policy for Apple App Store and Google Play payments, and register any employees with URSSAF and the occupational health service.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis
Statuts
RGPD personal data processing register and DPO designation
DSA information contact and transparency report template
Apple IAP / Google Play Billing integration agreements or records
Employment declarations, if any personnel are hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any change of governing information (registered office, gérant, capital) is submitted to the Guichet Unique within 30 days; a CNIL formal notice is cured by a remedial data-processing compliance plan; a DSA notice of non-compliance requires immediate content moderation policy amendments.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a fully digital voice-streaming activity; no industrial licence is required. If physical offices or data equipment are later established, the competent authorities are the DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) for environmental matters and the Préfecture for any ICPE classification.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating permit is mandatory for the SARL. The operating identity documents are the Extrait Kbis (RCS) and the SIRET/INSEE certificate; the application service operates under the LCEN and the EU Digital Services Act platform registration obligations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique et de la Cohésion des Territoires / DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 'Non-ICPE': the activity (ISIC 6311, interactive voice streaming platform) is not listed in the ICPE nomenclature, and no environmental impact assessment or environmental permit is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, noise or atmospheric emissions apply to the digital service. If the SARL occupies office premises, sanitary wastewater must comply with the Code de la santé publique and local sewerage by-laws; any cloud or data-centre subcontractors should adhere to the EU Code of Conduct for Data Centres and report energy efficiency metrics.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises: if the French workspace qualifies as a 5th-category ERP and exceeds 100 persons, a fire clearance from the Commission de Sécurité is required; below that threshold, compliance with the Code du travail rules on aeration, emergency exits and fire-fighting equipment suffices. Electrical installations must meet NF C 15-100 with a Consuel conformity certificate for new works. Occupational clearance: registration with URSSAF and the médecine du travail, first-aid provision, and display of workplace safety notices under Articles L.4621-1 et seq. of the Code du travail.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), French General Directorate of Public Finances, via the official portal impots.gouv.fr; corporate registrations and VAT formalities are processed through the Guichet Unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity forming a French SARL must register through the Guichet Unique, obtaining a SIREN and SIRET number and, when subject to VAT, a French VAT identification number assigned by DGFiP. Non-established foreign suppliers that make taxable supplies in France without a French establishment may apply directly to the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) for a French VAT number, and must appoint an individual tax representative approved by the DGFiP if they are established outside the European Union and have no fixed establishment in France.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in France. An SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) at entity level. A closely held SARL meeting certain qualitative conditions may irrevocably or temporarily opt for income tax treatment as a transparent partnership under Article 239 bis AA of the Code Général des Impôts (CGI). Hybrid mismatch elections under ATAD transposition are not elective in the ordinary sense; French law applies binding anti-hybrid adjustments, although optional transparency may apply to certain eligible entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) / Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For non-established foreign suppliers of electronic services to non-taxable French consumers, no registration threshold applies; VAT registration is mandatory from the first euro of taxable turnover. Domestic small-business thresholds (EUR 85,000 for supplies of goods and EUR 37,500 for supplies of services under Article 293 B CGI) are not available to non-resident electronic-services suppliers. Cross-border B2C e-services may instead be declared under the non-Union OSS scheme without a French VAT number.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Under the French e-invoicing reform, domestic B2B e-invoicing becomes mandatory progressively: from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-sized enterprises and from 1 September 2027 for small enterprises. Invoices must be transmitted through Chorus Pro or a registered dematerialisation platform (PDP) using Factur-X, UBL or CII formats. E-reporting of B2C and cross-border transactions to the DGFiP is required via a PDP within one business day of issuance. There is no blockchain-based digital stamping, but real-time fiscal clearance and structured digital reporting are mandated for all affected taxable persons.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Physical exports of goods from France to destinations outside the European Union qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 262 CGI provided the supplier proves actual physical export, files an export customs declaration, and retains the mandated transport and delivery documentation. Services directly related to the export of goods, and services supplied to a business customer established outside the EU, fall outside the scope of French VAT (Article 259-1 CGI) rather than being zero-rated; the supplier may nevertheless claim input VAT deduction or refund if strictly connected to taxable or foreign indeterminable transactions. For the voice streaming application, digital services rendered to non-EU business customers are considered outside the French territorial scope and may support input VAT recovery subject to Articles 259, 271 and 272 CGI.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Single Administrative Document (SAD / DAU) or electronic export declaration lodged in the DELTA system
Bill of Lading (BoL) or Air Waybill (AWB) evidencing physical departure from the European Union
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or corresponding bank transfer/FX settlement record demonstrating receipt of the export consideration
Transport contract and delivery receipt signed by the foreign customer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unfounded zero-rating triggers full retrospective VAT recovery, disallowance of input VAT deductions, and late-interest accrual at 0.20% per month. Civil penalties under Article 1729 CGI impose 40% for deliberate omissions or inaccuracies and 80% for abusive fraud or use of forged documents. Criminal sanctions under Article 1741 CGI include imprisonment of up to five years and a fine of up to EUR 500,000. Managers may be held civilly liable for corporate tax debts under Article L.267 of the Livre des Procédures Fiscales, and the DGFiP may apply comprehensive cross-border information exchange and anti-abuse audit procedures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), the National Central Bank, exercising delegated authority for France's foreign-exchange and financial-relations regulation (réglementation des relations financières avec l'étranger) under the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) of the Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique, with prudential supervision of credit institutions by the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in France. Current-account operations, including royalty payments, software licensing, platform service fees and profit remittances, are free of foreign-exchange licensing and capital-authorisation requirements. France applies complete capital-account openness under Article 63 TFEU: inbound equity subscription, SARL capital increases, dividend distribution and disposal of shares by non-resident investors are lawful through ordinary bank transfers. Residual frictions are reporting and screening based: each cross-border remittance equal to or exceeding 50,000 EUR equivalent is reported by the French credit institution to Banque de France under the TDF (Déclaration de Transaction Financière) framework; non-EU direct investment in a non-sensitive digital-content entity does not require prior Ministerial authorisation under Articles L.151-3 and R.151-4 CMF, except where the purchaser is from a high-risk third country, in which case an FDI notification may be prudent; and SARL dividends paid to a non-resident shareholder are freely transferable abroad but remain subject to French withholding tax at 25% unless reduced or eliminated under an applicable tax treaty, the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (0% rate, subject to a 10% shareholding held for at least 24 months), or Article 119 ter CGI for EU treaty residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no export-proceeds surrender, no mandatory repatriation deadline and no forced euro-conversion ratio. A French SARL may lawfully retain export and cross-border service receipts in foreign currency, provided receivables are recorded in French GAAP and any onshore EUR disbursement follows standard banking rules. The only compulsory obligation is statistical: payments to or from foreign countries equal to or exceeding 50,000 EUR equivalent are subject to monthly balance-of-payments reporting by the collecting French intermediary to Banque de France, and the SARL must preserve underlying invoices, contracts and account statements for a statutory limitation period of five years under Article L.102 B of the French Tax Procedure Book.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow and Operational EUR Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for EU/EEA-licensed e-money institutions (EMIs) passported into France under PSD2, such as Qonto, Shine, and Revolut Business, which may serve as operational expense and disbursement rails. Low for offshore, non-EEA digital EMIs, which cannot lawfully hold SARL client monies or execute SEPA and French domestic transfers without a French branch or an EU e-money or payment-institution passport. Critical legal constraint: an EMI is not a credit institution and cannot issue the 'attestation de dépôt de capital' certificate required by the French notary and the commercial registry (greffe du tribunal de commerce) for SARL capital subscription evidencing the bank holding of subscribed capital; therefore the capital-escrow function must be placed with a Tier 1 credit institution, while the EMI can be used as a low-value disbursement account with daily sweeping back to the Tier 1 operational EUR account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose an absolute physical-branch interview, but Tier 1 French banks generally require at least one in-person or certified video-identification session for each gérant (manager) and for every non-resident shareholder or UBO holding more than 25% of the SARL. Since the 2022 French AML transposition (Decree 2022-688) and ACPR guidance, remote onboarding is legally accepted when the video session is interactive, the identification is based on an eIDAS-qualified digital identity or a certified passport scan, and the corporate documentation is certified by apostille or notarised translation. In practice, onboarding risk for the ISIC 6311 voice-streaming model is Medium, and the recommended path is a physical meeting at the Paris branch of BNP Paribas or Société Générale with the presenting gérant, together with complete RBE-register filings and company Kbis extract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU UBO chain and undisclosed beneficial ownership, compounded by directors residing outside France.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport copies of all gérants and UBOs; notarised and apostilled board or shareholder resolution authorising account opening; SARL Kbis extract; Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) filing; six-month source-of-funds bank statements for each contributing shareholder; source-of-wealth declaration; proof of residential address; and, if the shareholder is a corporate vehicle, complete ownership-chain evidence down to the individual level.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value micro-payment flows and virtual-gift or tipping monetisation flagged as potential layering via user wallets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentary evidence that all user payments ingress exclusively through Apple App Store In-App Purchase and Google Play Billing, comprising platform payout statements, PSP merchant settlement reports, transaction-monitoring procedures, an approved AML/CTF programme under Articles L.561-5 CMF and L.561-2 French transposition, a refund policy, and a business-rules architecture that prohibits user-to-user wallet cash-outs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential exposure to sanctioned persons or high-risk jurisdictions through unvetted streaming users.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IP-geoblocking evidence, device-fingerprint records, an IP-country blocking list aligned with OFAC, EU and French sanctions registers, automated sanctions-sanctions and-PEP screening outputs covering platform users and counterparties, and an external legal memorandum from a French avocat confirming that no sanctioned-jurisdiction payments are cleared or settled in the SARL treasury accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of an EMI or fintech as the primary operating account may contravene the commercial registry's capital-deposit attestation requirement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A signed treasury policy letter confirming that capital escrow remains with a Tier 1 credit institution, that the EMI is used only as a disbursement agent, that daily EUR sweeps are executed back to the operational EUR account, and that the SARL maintains a single financial-account mapping for French tax and statutory audit purposes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant route is a SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's non-French bank into the SARL's French euro capital-escrow account. The instruction must include in field 50 the transferring shareholder, in field 33B the exact EUR amount, and in fields 70/77 the remittance purpose: 'Apport en numéraire lors de la souscription d'actions SARL (capital increase)'. The ECB balance-of-payments purpose code 'DIN - Direct Investment' should be quoted to enable Banque de France statistical classification; the receiving French bank will complete the monthly TDF report for amounts at or above 50,000 EUR. The SARL must preserve the shareholder resolution, the capital-subscription slip, the bank's attestation de dépôt de capital issued after irrevocable blocking, and the fingerprint registration document. For a capital injection of 100,000 EUR or more, or where the shareholder is from a high-risk third country, the bank will additionally require an updated source-of-funds package, a sanctions/PEP screening confirmation or other UBO evidence before clearing the wire.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For non-SEPA third-party suppliers (infrastructure, AI hosting, content licensing, affiliate networks), the primary clearing rail is a SWIFT MT103 tracked via SWIFT gpi with a Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UETR) in field 121; the payment message references the commercial invoice and transaction purpose code. For EU suppliers, use SEPA Credit Transfer (CT) in ISO 20022 XML. For high-value purchases, an irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit drawn on a French confirming bank (Crédit Agricole CIB, BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking, or Société Générale Global Banking & Advisory) may be issued, although documentary LC is not typically required for a digital streaming app with no physical inventory; the customised practice is advance payment or 30/60-day credit terms routed by MT103 with automatic reconciliation. All outbound disbursements above 50,000 EUR to non-EU beneficiaries are reported by the instructing French bank to Banque de France under the TDF monthly declaration, and the SARL must retain each invoice-backed payment order for five years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla EUR/USD and EUR/GBP outright foreign-exchange forwards (Livraison du contrat de change à terme) executed with ACPR-licensed credit institutions under an ISDA Master Agreement, with net amounts settled T+2.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted only where the underlying economic exposure is real, illiquid and non-EUR (e.g., user-credit settlements or platform distributor payouts), executed onshore with a registered credit institution; prohibited for speculative or leverage purposes.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps between EUR and a funding currency, permitted only if the SARL holds financial debt or lease liabilities, with EMIR clearing and transaction reporting obligations satisfied.

European-style FX options and zero-cost collars purchased for hedging revenue-side currency exposure, limited to the amount of forecast cross-border inflows under the SARL's board-approved treasury policy; no unhedged speculation beyond documented transactional exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary shareholders' meeting approving annual accounts and allocation of results
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed with a government authority; minutes entered in the company's compulsory decision register and retained at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the financial year; for a 31 December year-end, approval must occur by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No fixed monetary penalty for a late meeting itself, but any shareholder may seek a court order via the tribunal de commerce appointing a judicial mandate to convene the meeting; persistent non-action may expose managers to civil liability and support a creditor or prosecutor application for judicial dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels) with supporting documents and shareholder meeting minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after approval of the annual accounts; for a 31 December year-end approved by 30 June, filing is due by 30 July unless a court-ordered extension is granted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to comply exposes the legal representative to fines of up to €1,500 for natural persons and €4,500 for legal entities (Code de commerce art. L232-24); repeated non-deposit after formal notice may result in an injunction proceeding and, eventually, administrative strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual company income tax return and tax financial statements (liasse fiscale relation n° 2065-SD and related schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP), submitted electronically via net-entreprises.fr or EFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar financial year ending 31 December, file by the second business day following 1 May of the next calendar year; for a non-calendar financial year, within the statutory two-month filing window following the close of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the assessed corporate income tax, increased to 10% where the return remains unfiled within 30 days after a formal notice; monthly late-payment interest accrues at 0.40% on unpaid amounts; continued non-filing may trigger raised tax assessments and prosecution for failure to file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership declaration update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) when shareholding or beneficial ownership changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS with the dossier of the SARL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after any transfer of SARL shares or change in the identity, control, or benefit of any beneficial owner; no separate annual re-filing is required when the registered data remain current
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to declare or maintain correct beneficial-ownership data is punishable by fine up to €7,500 for natural persons and €37,500 for legal entities; false declarations may also suspend other RCS filings and expose managers to criminal or civil liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is compulsory for a French SARL when it exceeds at least two of the three following thresholds at financial year-end: total balance-sheet assets exceeding €4,000,000; net revenue excluding VAT exceeding €8,000,000; and average employee headcount exceeding 50. A minority shareholder or public prosecutor may also obtain a court-appointed auditor, and smaller SARLs may voluntarily appoint one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the Plan Comptable Général (ANC Regulation 2014-03), with the preparation of annual accounts per Code de commerce articles L123-12 to L123-23; consolidated financial statements of groups may use IFRS as adopted in the EU, but individual SARL statutory accounts must follow French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a standalone annual UBO return. The SARL must maintain an accurate internal beneficial-ownership record and file an amended declaration of beneficial owners with the RCS within 30 days of any change in the share register or ownership structure. Before each approval of annual accounts, the manager should verify that the registered beneficial-ownership data remain materially correct, and any discrepancy must be corrected immediately.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of share movements and registered securities (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of corporate decisions and shareholders' meetings (registre des délibérations et assemblées)
Minute book and supporting attendance sheets and proxies retained at the registered office

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $800 - $3,500 depending on city and structure, with standard French registered-office domiciliation services costing approximately $400 - $1,600 and full legal secretarial and compliance-agent mandates costing $2,000 - $4,500
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $6,000 - $20,000 for a threshold-triggered statutory audit; below the statutory thresholds no audit is mandatory and annual accounts preparation is normally included in the accounting or compliance retainer

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit for entities with turnover below €10M (art. 219 CGI); R&D tax credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible expenditure; 'Jeune Entreprise Innovante' (JEI) partial exemptions; 3% digital services tax (art. 299 CGI) once French digital revenue exceeds €7.5M and global digital revenue exceeds €25M; loss carryforward is unlimited with an annual utilization cap of €1M plus 50% of the taxable surplus; loss carryback limited to €1M over 5 fiscal years.
